purpose: Run CUBE refinement as two coordinated eight-shard cloud swarms converging on a shared figure-eight handoff path while preserving truth and authority boundaries.

topology.name: FIGURE_8
topology.convergence: Both loops feed the same Gauntlet/Elohim handoff boundary; no swarm is an economic authority.

shard_partition: global shard index 0..15; deterministic hash partition prevents the two swarms from targeting the same opportunity bucket.
economic_rule: verified economic return must justify additional resource consumption
truth: Pinball may refine opportunities but may not invent buyers, payments, demand, evidence, revenue, or integrations.
replication: Only independently verified economic mechanisms may be promoted for replication.
local_gpu_lane: OPTIONAL; cloud swarm remains independently operable when the local machine is offline.
